Subject: Quick follow-up — economic buyer & procurement steps (Catalyst Inc)

Hi Alex & Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning — good conversation and appreciate the transparency on timeline and requirements. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

Summary
- Use case: internal knowledge search + customer support summarization for multi-product docs (initial pilot ~50k chats/month).
- Success criteria: 95th p50 latency < 300ms for chat generation, embeddings for vector search with 99% availability during support hours, and per-ticket cost target below $0.02/token (TBD).
- Integration: hosted API for pilot; potential Dedicated capacity if we need VPC/isolation later.

Open asks / next steps
1) Economic buyer / budget owner: you mentioned finance is involved. Can you confirm who the economic buyer is for this project (name/title/email)? We typically loop them into the mutual action plan and procurement timeline.
2) Procurement checklist: can you share any standard procurement docs or SOC2/Infosec questionnaire deadline?
3) Demo: I can schedule a tailored demo next Wednesday (2/16) — would that work?

I've attached the discovery notes and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) with an example timeline. 

Attachments:
- discovery-notes.pdf (call summary)
- mutual-action-plan-v1.xlsx (draft MAP)

If helpful, we can provide a short intro email template for the economic buyer to keep the chain warm. Happy to coordinate a three-way intro if you prefer.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — great recap. Quick answers: 

- Economic buyer / budget owner: Priya Sharma, VP Finance (priya.sharma@catalystinc.com). Priya owns the budget for new vendor SaaS tools and will sign off on pilots over $50k.
- Procurement: Procurement wants a completed vendor intake + SOC 2 Type II report before legal review. Procurement checklist attached. Typical procurement window is 3-4 weeks once we have the intake and SOC2.
- Timeline: We are aiming for an executive review the week of 3/7 and a pilot kickoff mid-March if everything lines up.

On the demo timing — 2/16 works for us for a focused demo for the product + infra/SC. Priya might join the exec review later in the process; for now please start the MAP with the pilot budget line item and procurement steps.
